revisions.title: What Musical Education Must Teach
revisions.body: Musical training matters here because it teaches citizens what to enjoy. Its goal is not performance or pleasure treated as an end in itself, but the formation of taste that responds to order and measure. The city therefore judges music by the kind of character its pleasures cultivate.

revisions.title: Developmental summary
revisions.body: This passage offers a developmental summary without assigning the discussion to a numbered book.

revisions.title: Place and Law
revisions.body: Here the governing question is the fit between a city’s setting and the laws it can sustain. The relation to the sea is not background scenery; it is part of the political inquiry.

revisions.title: The Question of Political Measure
revisions.body: A useful listening question here is whether any single qualification can serve as a complete title to political authority.
